problems.title: "Get in" goes straight into a 7-screen sign-up with no look around first; interests are asked twice
problems.summary: All four first-open personas noted "Get in" jumps into sign-up with a 7-dash progress bar. The how-Lumi-helps screen read as a wall of English text; the second interest picker repeated the first. Jordan quit on the how-Lumi-helps screen without signing up.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: The new onboarding (merged 2026-11-03) kept all earlier screens around the mockup's four steps, so it is still 7 screens before any content, with two overlapping interest pickers and a text-only explainer.

evidence.quote: ok and? I picked clubs and you show me a wall of text about clubs. 4 more dashes to go. boring.
wait I didn't even get to look around. 7 steps?? ugh.
Didn't I just answer this? I already said clubs and meeting people. This is the fifth screen and I still haven't seen a single club.
아 귀찮아... another picker. still haven't seen a single person or the app itself
또 질문... 이메일은 언제 해? 그냥 Skip 할래.

problems.suggestedFix: Let people browse before sign-up (or after name + school only); merge "What would you like to discover?" into "What brings you"; shorten the how-Lumi-helps cards to one line each.

problems.title: Sign-up says birth year is "never shown on your profile", but profiles show age and the privacy policy says so
problems.summary: Aisha read the Privacy Policy ("your age shows on your profile") then the sign-up hint "Only to check you’re 16+. Never shown on your profile." The app does show age next to the name on Home and person pages.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: The hint was added in the 2026-11-03 onboarding change (claude/onboarding-4step) without checking the profile pages; it is factually wrong.

evidence.quote: Also the privacy page I just read said my age sho…
evidence.note: Verified in code: PersonPage/HomePage render current year − birthYear + 1 next to the name.

problems.suggestedFix: Change the hint to "Used to check you’re 16+. Your age shows on your profile." (or stop showing age) — one-line copy fix in StartPage.

problems.environmentNote: Content is the live events snapshot (real), so likely the same on live today.
problems.title: Welcome teasers and first "For you" cards are grad/career items for undergrads
problems.summary: Three undergrads saw grad-oriented teaser cards on /welcome; after picking clubs / meet people, Home "For you" led with a Grad Student Appreciation Party or a law careers panel.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Teaser and For-you ranking ignore the role (undergrad) and the goals just picked; recent live events happen to be grad/career-heavy.

evidence.quote: 뭐지... where's the lunch thing I saw at the start? 'For you' = grad student party?? I'm 17 lol. not for me
but a DOE grad research thing as a teaser card? not me.
But 'For you' is a law job panel? I said clubs and campus events, not careers.

problems.suggestedFix: Filter teasers/For-you by role (hide grad-only items for undergrads) and boost the categories picked in onboarding.

problems.environmentNote: Local stack has no other students; stronger than live, but the empty state is real at quiet times.
problems.title: A brand-new account finds nobody to meet: Meetups and "Who's free right now" are empty
problems.summary: After signing up, Minji and Seoyeon found Meetups ("No meetups yet") and Who's free empty; Minji quit there.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Same as 2026-11-02: no fallback for an empty campus except "start one".

evidence.quote: 헐 nobody's here. I'm not gonna be the first one to make a meetup, I'm 17 and new, that's so awkward
아 again empty. 'Who's free' but no one is shown

problems.suggestedFix: See 2026-11-02 analysis: low-pressure "count me in" signal instead of "create the first meetup".

problems.title: Club says "Not recruiting right now" under a big "Ask to join"; nothing says what happens next
problems.summary: Aisha gave up on the hiking club's Recruiting tab — third persona in two days.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: CTA ignores recruiting state; no next-step copy.

evidence.quote: Wait, does 'not recruiting' mean I can't join a hiking club right now? Then what does 'Ask to join' do — send them a message with my profile?

problems.suggestedFix: Label/explain the button when not recruiting; after sending, say who sees it.

problems.title: The club list opens with professional/Greek fraternities ("matches your interest in careers") before casual clubs
problems.summary: Aisha (picked clubs + meet people, not careers) saw business/tech fraternities tagged "Matches your interest in careers" first; casual clubs were two scrolls down. Same pattern for Minji on 2026-11-02.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Interest matching maps onboarding picks (e.g. "Discover opportunities") to careers, and the list leads with professional orgs.

evidence.quote: Wait, 'matches your interest in careers'? I never said careers, I said clubs and meeting people.

problems.suggestedFix: Rank social/casual clubs first for students who picked "Meet new people"; check the onboarding → interest mapping.

problems.summary: Seoyeon and Minji looked for 한국어 and found none before sign-up.

harnessIssues.title: privacy page placeholders are local-only
harnessIssues.detail: Aisha saw "[operator name — to be set]" on /privacy: LEGAL_NAME / PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL are not set on the local stack. Check live has them set; if not, that is a real launch blocker. Grouped under birth-year problem fingerprint 4381a718da05 only for the age contradiction.
